metadata.calendar_system: Julian calendar assumed for historical game chronology unless project states otherwise

source_policy.event_selection_rule: Include only source-attested historical events that affect Novgorod Land directly or indirectly; local manifestations are gameplay projections of those events.
source_policy.date_policy: Every phase gets an assigned_game_datetime to the hour. Assigned datetimes are simulation anchors, not exact historical dates unless source_date_is_exact and assigned_datetime_is_game_anchor is false.
source_policy.rumor_policy: Rumor is not fact; player-visible truth status remains unknown.
source_policy.hidden_knowledge_policy: Future phases, hidden motives, objective truth of rumors and exact unseen decisions must not be shown to the player.

map_binding_policy.fallback_rule: If the event occurs outside the generated map, bind it to nearest existing semantic nodes: routes, gates, torg, authority yards, river landings or border-facing corridors.
map_binding_policy.map_archive_status: Canonical G1-G4 is closed for runtime extension; party-level manifestations must use G5/NPC/item/etc. limits.
